note: Curated fallback alternatives (design E6.7). Every percentage is an ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO PARAMETER, not an engineering design, vendor quotation or measured figure. Reductions are per pollution domain, in percent of the machine's current per-day intensity; all are >= 0. The deterministic engine computes every total and payback from these inputs.

textile.name: Low-liquor-ratio jet dyeing machine
textile.rationale: A lower liquor ratio heats less water per kilogram of fabric and uses less dye-bath chemistry, cutting steam demand, effluent volume and chemical load.
textile.assumptions: Replaces the existing dyeing duty; capex as a share of the current machine's replacement value.

textile.name: Waste-heat-recovery economiser retrofit on the exhaust
textile.rationale: Recovers flue-gas heat to pre-heat feed water or air, so less fuel is burned for the same heat duty.
textile.assumptions: Retrofit to the existing unit; no change to the dyeing process.

textile.name: Cold pad-batch / low-temperature reactive dyeing
textile.rationale: Fixes reactive dyes at ambient temperature over a batching period, avoiding most bath heating and reducing water and salt use.
textile.assumptions: Suitable for cellulosic fabrics and compatible shades only.

textile.name: Closed-loop effluent treatment with water reuse in the dye house
textile.rationale: Treats and recycles dye-house water, cutting fresh-water intake and discharged effluent and chemical load.
textile.assumptions: Adds treatment operating cost; no energy saving assumed.

textile.name: Modular refurbish-and-upgrade of the existing machine
textile.rationale: Replaces the pump, heat-exchanger and control modules instead of building a new machine, keeping the frame and avoiding new-build material.
textile.assumptions: Frame and vessel in serviceable condition.

metals.name: Regenerative-burner reheating furnace
metals.rationale: Regenerative burners store and return flue-gas heat to the combustion air, cutting fuel per tonne reheated.
metals.assumptions: Burner and control replacement at a planned rebuild.

metals.name: Induction melting furnace replacing fuel-fired melting
metals.rationale: Electric induction melting removes on-site combustion and reduces slag and dust, at a higher electricity cost.
metals.assumptions: Grid electricity cost is the extra operating cost; grid emissions are outside this machine-level view.

metals.name: Scrap pre-heating and combustion tuning
metals.rationale: Pre-heating the charge with off-gas and tuning the air-fuel ratio lowers fuel per tonne.

metals.name: Closed-loop quench/cooling water and slag valorisation
metals.rationale: Recirculates quench and cooling water and routes slag to reuse instead of landfill.

metals.name: Prefabricated modular refractory lining and an electrification-ready burner skid at rebuild
metals.rationale: Prefabricated refractory modules cut rebuild waste and heat loss; an electrification-ready skid avoids a second rebuild later.
metals.assumptions: Done at the next scheduled rebuild.

chemicals.name: Dryer with exhaust heat recovery
chemicals.rationale: Recovers heat from the dryer exhaust to pre-heat inlet air, lowering fuel per tonne of powder.
chemicals.assumptions: Replaces or retrofits the drying stage.

chemicals.name: Membrane separation replacing a thermal evaporation step
chemicals.rationale: Membranes concentrate or separate streams without boiling them, cutting steam use and effluent load.

chemicals.name: Solvent and process-water recycling loop
chemicals.rationale: Recovers solvent and process water for reuse, reducing chemical release, effluent and residue disposal.
chemicals.assumptions: Recovery unit added to the existing line.

chemicals.name: Continuous-flow process intensification replacing a batch step
chemicals.rationale: Continuous flow with better heat and mass transfer uses less energy and solvent per unit and raises throughput.
chemicals.assumptions: Chemistry suitable for continuous operation; process-safety review required.

chemicals.name: Skid-mounted modular unit with heat integration designed in at assembly
chemicals.rationale: A factory-assembled skid with heat integration avoids site-built piping losses and reduces fugitive releases.
chemicals.assumptions: At the next unit replacement or expansion.

mining.name: Electric or hybrid drive replacing diesel or genset drive
mining.rationale: Electric drive removes on-site combustion at the machine; electricity is the extra operating cost.
mining.assumptions: Grid or captive power available; grid emissions are outside this machine-level view.

mining.name: High-efficiency kiln or dryer with heat recovery
mining.rationale: Better insulation, seals and heat recovery lower fuel per tonne processed.

mining.name: Dry-stack tailings with water recycling
mining.rationale: Dewatering tailings for dry stacking recovers process water and reduces seepage and land-take.
mining.assumptions: Adds filtration operating cost; no energy saving assumed.

mining.name: Dust suppression and closed-circuit grinding optimisation
mining.rationale: Closed-circuit classification avoids over-grinding and dust suppression cuts fugitive particulate and spillage.

mining.name: Remanufacture of worn major components instead of new fabrication
mining.rationale: Remanufacturing liners and girth-gear segments with low-carbon-steel replacements avoids new fabrication material and energy.
